goal: Reduce durable mailbox inbox polling work without losing/reordering messages or changing contracts
scope: Local SQLite synthetic envelope workload, no LLM/token/e2e quality claim
hypothesis: A recipient/sequence partial index over receipt IS NULL avoids scanning acknowledged deliveries; measure existing query before deciding whether an ordered query adjustment is needed.
invariants: same exact inbox result and FIFO order
all references and budget checks unchanged

measurement.timer: perf_counter_ns, full Mailbox.inbox including connection and JSON
measurement.primary: SQLite VM instructions via progress handler separately from uninstrumented timing
measurement.acceptance: Exact behavior all cases; >80% VM-step decrease and >=2x median on acknowledged-backlog cases; report all controls and write overhead. No timing gate in unit tests.
measurement.other_runs: Other runs never ACK; target run0 prefix ACK. Population uses actual public publish/ack once per fixture then SQLite backup into equivalent arms. All setup outside timing.
measurement.write_measurement: 31 paired new publish calls and31 paired ACK calls on each workload after read measurements; events increase identically; report median,p95 and storage before/after index; single first index creation timed separately.
measurement.construction: deterministic: event i run=i%runs, local event index=i//runs. ACK floor(events/runs*ack_fraction) prefix events of target run only; every recipient ACKed in that prefix. fixed summary/action and referenced two-byte {} artifact; event_id decimal i; JSON canonical UTF8.
measurement.candidate_budget: One fixed integration candidate; keep old evidence, no changing thresholds.
measurement.index_sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS communication_pending_recipient_seq ON communication_deliveries(recipient,seq) WHERE receipt IS NULL
